tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /badz+ra bhai ra ba'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa bzhugs/

'dir sbyin sreg bsdus pa ni/ sa stegs gru bzhi khru phyed do zhig gi steng du thabs khung gru gsum nang gi rgya la che na khru gang*/ 'bring la yang sor nyi shu/ chung na mtho gang yod/ dpang du rgya'i cha phyed srab 'thug rtse mor sor gsum gcig bya/ rang gi mdun du hom khung gi nang du liṅga khrag gis byugs pa gcig bcug dmar gtor gru gsum dang mchod pa spyi dang mthun pa dang*/ rak+ta nang mchod la sogs pa yang bshams/ thab kyi nang du drag po la tsher ma can dang*/ zhi ba la lci skam mam dge ba'i shing gis gang bar byed/ drag po la tsher ma can gyi shing dang*/ shing brul sogs kyis gang bar byed/ thabs kyi nang du ting lo zhig bzhag go /thabs nang gi 'bud shing dang mtshungs pa'i yam shing rang gi g.yon phyogs su bsag de bzhin du rgyas dbang gsum la dkar gyi mar khu dang*/ drag po la rke tshes mar khu dgos/ 'bru mar gzhan nas ji ltar 'os pa gnyis ka la phul ba'i chog gzhan sreg rdzas kyi dngos po 'bru rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ rtsa ku sha zhi rgyas dbang gsum la zas mchog drag po la sha khrag sna tshogs dang*/ bong bu'i sbangs dang*/ skra shad dang*/ dur khrod kyi rus pa la sogs pa dgos shing*/ mes bsregs par 'os pa gang 'dzoms pa de phul bas chog de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs dang*/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bar bya ste/ nang mchod gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ dang*/ ya man+ta ka= mang du bzlas/ bsreg rdzas rnams la/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ oṃ hrīṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan gsum re bzlas/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ/ zhes dpa' 'bar gyis me sbar te thabs nang gi ting lo sbar ro/ / hūṃ hūṃ zhes rlung yab kyis g.yabs so/ /spyir sbyin sreg gi me rlung yab kyis g.yab/ sbud pas 'bud du rung*/ khas 'bud par mi bya'o/ / oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa

sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i thab yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ raṃ las me'i phung po nyid drang srong chen po me lha/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la/ bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ drag po la/ nag po srin po ltar khros pa gri gug 'dzin pa'o/ / yang*/ ya man+ta ka sa bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ me lha'i snying gar rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po/ bdag bskyed ltar yongs su rdzogs par bskyed de/ dbu rgyan gyi rgyas btab pa'i 'bar ro/ /yang na skad cig gis bskyed pa'i kyang chog ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gzugs sgra la sogs pa nas dud kha mun can gyi bar brjod/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ 'i mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ bdag gi bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig ces pa'am/ dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mar khu 'bul lo/ /hrīḥṣ+tīḥ'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar/ yam shing 'bul/ de nas sreg rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ bi kṛ ta na na/ ch+gai mo ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes btags pa kho nas 'bul lo/ /zhi ba la ch+gai mo mar ra ya'i tshab tu ma ma shan+tiṃ ku ru zhes pa'o/ /drag po'i las la bar 'dir liṅga dgug gzhug nas sgrol tshig gi bar drug cu pa'i gtor chog nas bshad pa bzhin bya la/ ling ro rnams gong bzhin ltar gsad sngags spel ba des 'bul/ de rjais gtor ma la dmigs nas mngon rtogs nas bshad pa ltar gtor chog yongs rdzogs bya/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzla/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ sogs/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod sogs/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa las kyang shin tu bsdus pa 'di/ chos bzang nyi mas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ badz+ra bhai ra ba'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa bzhugs/
